a.lede: New dock and app launcher arrive while soaring memory prices revive scrutiny of a two-year-old firmware restriction
a.title: Thoughts return to forbidden RAM upgrades as Raspberry Pi OS gets fresh lick of paint

b.lede: Raspberry Pi users are being firmware blocked from swapping the RAM chips on their SBCs for repairs or upgrades.
b.title: Raspberry Pi locks boards to factory RAM capacities in firmware — engineer tells DIY modders 'don't waste your time' trying repairs or upgrades, company cites shady reseller scams
